title: Residual Calibration via Local Feature-Space Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.30652v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks often struggle to provide reliable confidence estimates, making post-hoc calibration essential for reliable decision-making. Existing post-hoc methods largely rely on score-based transformations, which improve marginal calibration but often fail to capture spatially varying miscalibration in local regions of the learned feature space. To address this gap, we propose Local Adaptive Probability Estimation (LAPE), a post-hoc residual calibration framework. Specifically, LAPE treats the global calibrator output as a stable anchor and refines the individual prediction by leveraging non-parametric local evidence from neighboring calibration samples. As a plug-and-play refinement module, LAPE effectively utilizes the information about feature-space geometry and can reuse the calibration data that are used to construct the global calibrator. Furthermore, we extend LAPE to the setting with multi-view inputs through Cascade

translated_title: 基于局部特征空间精细化的残差校准
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络往往难以提供可靠的置信度估计，这使得事后校准对于可靠的决策至关重要。现有的事后校准方法主要依赖于基于分数的变换，这类方法虽然能够改善边际校准，但往往无法捕捉学习到的特征空间中局部区域的、随空间变化的失准现象。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了局部自适应概率估计，这是一种事后残差校准框架。具体而言，LAPE 将全局校准器的输出视为稳定的锚点，并利用来自相邻校准样本的非参数局部证据来对单个预测进行精细化。作为一个即插即用的精细化模块，LAPE 能够有效利用特征空间几何信息，并且可以复用用于构建全局校准器的校准数据。此外，我们通过级联方式将 LAPE 扩展到多视图输入的场景中。
tldr: 提出了局部自适应概率估计（LAPE），一种即插即用的事后残差校准框架，它以全局校准器输出为锚点，利用相邻校准样本的非参数局部证据对预测进行精细化，从而捕捉特征空间中局部区域的空间变化失准。
en_tdlr: We propose Local Adaptive Probability Estimation (LAPE), a plug-and-play post-hoc residual calibration framework that treats the global calibrator output as an anchor and refines predictions using non-parametric local evidence from neighboring calibration samples, capturing spatially varying miscalibration in local regions of the feature space.
